in_sanskrit.name: लोशिता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Daughter of Lohitāgni, the red-colored fire god.

in_marathi.name: Loshita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Loshita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Loshita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lohit', which means 'red'. The suffix 'ita' denotes a 'lotus'. This name symbolizes the divine union of spiritual knowledge and material prosperity, represented by the red lotus. It is also associated with the Goddess Lakshmi, who embodies wealth, fortune, and prosperity.
